# protobuf-net

Version 2.4.9, .NET Framework 4.5.2 assembly, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://www.nuget.org/packages/protobuf-net/2.4.9

The assembly is pinned and included here so the Windows compiler build needs no
package restore. This framework target has no NuGet dependencies. The build
embeds it in both executables; users continue to run a single executable.

Upstream repository commit: f4bacb1a94c86e2e47de93e1a4627e3c37fd88ed.
